name: Cadence Design Systems
thesis: Cadence Design Systems — the other EDA major (software + design IP + system analysis), the cleaner pure-play of the duopoly with best-in-class margins. Identical picks-and-shovels logic to Synopsys: every AI chip — accelerators, custom hyperscaler silicon, chiplets, edge — is designed and verified on Cadence/Synopsys tools, regardless of which chip or model wins. The bet: as AI token consumption and the variety of models/workloads grow, chip variety and per-design complexity rise super-linearly, expanding EDA/IP intensity per design. Signals: (1) revenue compounds low-double-digit (steady ~14% for years), (2) the ~$7.8B RPO (~1.5x revenue) keeps growing as the forward design-demand signal, (3) AI-driven verification/system design and IP — the highest-complexity, highest-value layers — outgrow the core, (4) the elite margin structure holds: ~86% gross, ~31% GAAP operating, ~30% FCF margin, with SBC only ~9% of revenue (far cleaner than the consumption-SaaS names) — that margin profile IS the proof of duopoly pricing power. Cleaner than Synopsys (no Ansys-scale integration to digest). Competitive reality: rational duopoly (both win as the pie grows); the risks are customer concentration in a handful of hyperscalers/foundries and the China/export-control overhang on EDA.
key_driver: EDA + IP revenue growth and RPO/backlog expansion at elite margins — design activity x rising complexity per design

tier_1_kpis.name: Revenue YoY Growth (USD)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <8% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs (design/chip-variety demand stalling)

tier_1_kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO)
tier_1_kpis.current: $7.8B FY25 (~1.5x revenue) — the forward design-demand signal
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: RPO declines YoY for 2 consecutive Qs (customers pulling back on multi-year design commitments)

tier_1_kpis.name: Operating Margin (GAAP)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <25% for 2 consecutive Qs (pricing power eroding / cost discipline slipping)

tier_2_kpis.name: R&D / Revenue
tier_2_kpis.current: ~33% FY25 (the cost of staying ahead on complexity)

tier_2_kpis.name: SBC / Revenue
tier_2_kpis.current: ~9% FY25 (notably clean — GAAP and non-GAAP are close, unlike the SaaS names)

nuance.bear_case: Cadence trades at a rich multiple precisely because the margin/FCF profile is elite and the duopoly is understood — so the equity risk is multiple compression, not fundamentals, if AI-infra sentiment cools. EDA demand is downstream of semiconductor R&D budgets; an AI-capex digestion cycle or a hyperscaler trimming custom-silicon programs would show up in RPO first. Customer concentration (foundries + a few hyperscalers) and China/export controls are the structural overhangs.
nuance.adversarial_take: Picks-and-shovels on AI is now consensus, and CDNS already prices it — ~14% growth is steady but not accelerating, so the thesis is 'durable compounding at a premium multiple,' not asymmetric upside. The 'increasing variety/complexity' tailwind is real but slow-moving; it protects the floor more than it lifts the ceiling.
nuance.stress_test: If revenue growth falls below 8% AND RPO declines YoY, the 'more/more-complex chips' demand thesis is breaking; a slip in operating margin below 25% alongside would signal the duopoly pricing power is cracking.

competitive_watchlist: Open-source EDA (long-tail, not yet a threat)
thesis_breakers_qualitative: Revenue growth below 8% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs
RPO declines YoY for 2 consecutive Qs (forward design demand contracting)
GAAP operating margin slips below 25% (pricing power / cost discipline cracking)
FCF margin regresses below 20% (the elite cash profile breaking)
China/export-control action or a hyperscaler in-sourcing design tooling

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
GAAP operating margin negative for 2 consecutive quarters — catastrophic for a name that runs 31% (this would mean total business breakage).
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken (catastrophic floor; per-ticker watch is 20%).
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue growth below 8% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs — design/chip-variety demand stalling below the steady mid-teens run-rate.
GAAP operating margin below 25% for 2 consecutive Qs — duopoly pricing power eroding or cost discipline slipping (FY25 ran 31%).
RPO declining YoY for 2 consecutive Qs — multi-year design backlog contracting, the leading EDA demand signal. (UNRESOLVED until an RPO-YoY transform KPI is materialized.)
FCF margin below 20% for 2 consecutive Qs — the elite cash-conversion profile (FY25 ran 30%) regressing materially.
